BLiNX 2 v1 - windows-x86_64
================================================================

PRIVATE: This bundle contains your own copy of BLiNX 2 and code generated
from it. It is for your own machines only. The game is not yours to
redistribute: never share, upload or publish this bundle.

This is a static recompilation of the original Xbox game, built on your
machine from your own disc dump by the blinx2-recomp project. It is not
affiliated with the game's owners. Built from: cat abcdef0, toolkit abcdef0.

Saves and settings live outside the program files and survive every
install, update and uninstall:

  %LOCALAPPDATA%\BLiNX2\   (hdd, config, logs)

  hdd/      the emulated Xbox hard disk: your save games
  config/   config.toml (graphics options) and launch.env (your own
            launcher settings, KEY=value lines, e.g. RECOMP_PB_BACKEND=cpu)
  logs/     one log per launch, the newest 10 kept

The options come from two files. config.default.toml, in the program
files, lists every option at its default; the game reads it on each launch
and an update replaces it, so new options and defaults reach you. Your
config/config.toml holds only the options you change (copy a line from
config.default.toml and edit it); the game creates it with a short comment
on the first launch and never overwrites it. Environment variables, such
as the lines in config/launch.env, override both. An earlier version's
config/enhance.toml is renamed to config.toml once.

Frame pacing defaults to "sleep": the game's frame wait sleeps until the
next vblank, which saves CPU and battery. "spin" is the console-original
timing, where that wait holds a CPU core as it did on the Xbox. To switch,
put

  [present]
  pacing = "spin"

in config/config.toml, or RECOMP_PRESENT_PACING=spin in config/launch.env.


Install v1
